sources.entry: Freeter - App that allows you to gather everything you need for work in one place, organized by projects and workflows, and have a quick access to them.

summary.one_liner: Freeter is a free, open-source desktop organizer that gathers the files, apps and resources you need for work into workflows and projects for quick access.
summary.what_it_does: Freeter lets you group everything you need for work in one place, organized by projects and workflows. You open your setup with the Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+F shortcut or from the tray icon. The README says it is meant to let you switch between workflows and reduce context-switching. The README does not list specific item types or integrations. Installers are provided on the project's download page for Linux, Windows and macOS. The README also includes steps for building the app from source with npm.
use_cases: organize work projects and workflows on desktop
quick access to work setup via keyboard shortcut or tray icon
gather work resources in one place
how_to_run: Download the source code from the download page or GitHub releases page
Built package is placed in ./dist (or use ready-made installers from the download page)
notable: Opens setup with Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+F or from the tray icon
Organizes work by projects and workflows
Supports Linux, Windows 10+, and macOS 10.15+ (Intel and Apple Silicon)
caveats: Linux support is described as most distros on Intel 64-bit; Windows requires Intel 64-bit; macOS requires 10.15 or later
